purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: expert interview; vocabulary (世の中/性格/実感/依存/根本) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 世の中の変化を、研究されていますね。
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm curious focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、人の依存の仕方に注目しています。
lines.en: Yes, I focus on how people depend on things.
lines.style: composed sociologist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 依存は、性格にもよりますか?
lines.en: Does dependence depend on character too?
lines.style: curious young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 性格も、根本の要因の一つです。
lines.style: patient sociologist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 研究で、実感が変わりましたか?
lines.en: Did your research change how you feel about it?
lines.style: engaged young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 世の中の優しさを、実感しました。
lines.en: I came to feel society's kindness.
lines.style: composed sociologist voice, soft warm measured clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 根本の問題は、解けますか?
lines.en: Can the fundamental problem be solved?
lines.style: thoughtful young interviewer voice, soft warm focus throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 根本を見つめ続けることが、答えです。
lines.en: Keeping our eyes on the root is the answer.
lines.style: warm sociologist voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
